palette.primary_role: Page backgrounds, header, footer (dark dominant — energy, intensity, results). Equinox uses pure #000000 header. Peloton uses #181A1D for dark hero sections. F45/Orangetheory flip to white dominant.
palette.accent_role: CTA buttons, class type badges, pricing highlights, timer/urgency elements, progress indicators. Peloton: #D00C2A red. Orangetheory: #F26922 orange (iconic). F45: #cf2e2e red + #fcb900 yellow. Equinox: minimal accent usage.
palette.surface_role: Card backgrounds (dark on dark, or white cards on dark BG for contrast). Peloton: #F5F7F9 and #F7F7F7 light gray sections.
palette.neutral_role: Body text on dark backgrounds, secondary info, class times, trainer details. Equinox: #333333 body text. Peloton: #181A1D text. F45: #32373c + #abb8c3 gray.
palette.border_role: Card borders, input fields, dividers (subtle on dark bg)

Equinox Sans.note: Proprietary luxury brand font, paired with Messina Sans Mono for accents

agrandir-tight-bold.note: Custom condensed heading font for Peloton, paired with Inter for body

border_radius.pill: 50px (Orangetheory: 50px on CTA buttons - fully rounded pill)
border_radius.typical_button: 0px (Equinox, Peloton: sharp minimal) or 4px or 8px (F45) or 50px pill (Orangetheory)

button_styles.text: high-energy action (Start Free Trial, Join Now, Book a Class, Get Started, Claim Your Pass, Home Trial)
button_styles.text_transform: uppercase (Bebas Neue / Oswald) or sentence case (boutique, Equinox, Peloton)

button_styles.color: white or accent or dark (#333333 on light, white on dark)
button_styles.text: View Schedule, Learn More, See Trainers, Class Details, Visit a Club
Used on dark backgrounds for secondary emphasis
Navigation CTAs, secondary links, 'Apparel', 'Visit a Club'

elevation.shadows: dramatic on dark bg, minimal on light (Orangetheory: none on cards, Equinox: minimal/flat)
typical_values: none (Orangetheory, some Equinox sections — flat design)

typical_order: header (sticky, dark or transparent bg, logo left, nav center, CTA right)
hero (full-bleed action photo or video + bold headline + subheadline + primary CTA + secondary CTA)
classes (grid: class type cards with name, intensity level, duration, description, schedule link)
about_philosophy (mission statement, gym culture, differentiators — 'Not just a gym, a community')
trainers (photo cards: action shot, name, specialties, certifications, Instagram/social, bio)
results_transformations (before/after photos + client name + story + time period + trainer)
membership_pricing (2-4 tier cards: basic/membership/premium, monthly rate, features, CTA per tier)
schedule (weekly class timetable grid or list with filters: day, class type, trainer, time)
facilities_amenities (photo grid: equipment, locker rooms, lounge, parking, showers, pro shop)
trial_cta (centered: 'First class free' or '7-day trial' or 'Home Trial' + form or button)
app_download (centered: App Store + Google Play badges, phone mockup, Peloton/Equinox+ app promotion)
equipment_shop (product grid: bikes, treadmills, accessories — Peloton-specific ecommerce section)
footer (3-column: about/hours/social + quick_links + newsletter + address + 'Join Now' CTA)
hero_variants: full_bleed_action (athlete/group workout photo, dark overlay, huge heading — CrossFit, gym, Equinox PageHero)
video_loop (high-intensity workout clips, slow-mo lifts, group class energy — Equinox, Barry's)
split_bold (text left, CTA, + action photo right — PT, boutique, Peloton product+copy split)
serene_ambient (yoga: natural light, calm pose, minimal overlay, soft typography — CorePower, yoga studios)
counter_hero (animated stat counters overlay: members, classes/week, trainers — F45, Orangetheory)
dark_minimal_luxury (Equinox: black bg, white 64px custom font headline, photo background, sharp corners, 'SUMMER BY EQUINOX' style)
product_hero (Peloton: dark bg with equipment photo, white headline + deal pricing, ecommerce-focused — 'Refurbished Original Bikes. Get yours for as low as $695.*')
brand_orange_hero (Orangetheory: white bg, large orange-accented text, clean photography, blue pill CTA)
class_card_variants: intensity_badge (class photo + name + intensity color badge + duration + 'Book' button)
icon_grid (icon per class type, name, description, schedule link — compact)
timetable_card (time slot, class name, trainer, spots remaining, book CTA — schedule-focused)
explore_club_card (Equinox: ExploreClubs section, location-based cards with club name, address, amenities)
pricing_variants: tier_cards (2-4 columns: monthly price, features checklist, CTA per tier, 'Most Popular' highlight)
simple_single (one price, all-access, 'Join Now' — boutique/simple gyms, Equinox 'One Membership' approach)
class_pack (buy credits/packs: 5/10/20 class packs, no monthly commitment, Orangetheory class packs)
equipment_pricing (Peloton: equipment purchase + separate membership, financing options, refurbished deals)
initiation_waiver (Equinox: '$0 initiation' + complimentary services package — luxury incentive pattern)

tone_profile.headline_style: bold, motivational, short (e.g., 'FIND YOUR STRONG', 'BECOME UNSTOPPABLE', 'THIS IS YOUR COMEBACK', 'STRENGTH IN COMMUNITY', 'SUMMER BY EQUINOX', 'One Membership. Limitless Potential.')
tone_profile.cta_style: urgent, action-driven (Start Free Trial, Join Now, Book Your First Class, Claim Your Pass, Get Started Today, Home Trial, Visit a Club)

equinox.subheadline_example: Join now to unlock $0 initiation and a complimentary suite of services valued at $500+.

peloton.headline_example: Refurbished Original Bikes. Get yours for as low as $695.*

orangetheory.focus: heart-rate based training, results tracking, community

f45.headline_example: Life Changing Group Fitness & Functional Training

trust_signals: trainer certifications (NASM, ACE, CSCS, Yoga Alliance, etc.)
before/after client transformations with real photos
free trial / first class free (risk reversal)
partnerships with brands (Nike, Lululemon, Rogue, etc.)
app store ratings (Peloton: 4.9+ stars, Equinox+ app)
anti_patterns: unrealistic body standards or aggressive body-shaming language
stock photos of models instead of real members/trainers
missing class schedule or 'Call for pricing'
generic 'fitness' stock imagery without brand personality

color_mood: dark_orange_energy (CrossFit/gym: #0a0a0a bg, #ff4500 accent, Bebas Neue, sharp edges, raw industrial)
dark_red_intensity (Barry's/ HIIT: #111111 bg, #e63946 red accent, bold sans, high contrast)
black_lime_explosive (Nike Training: #000000 bg, #00c853 neon green, dynamic angles, performance)
dark_white_zen (yoga/Pilates: #f5f5f5 or white bg, #7c4dff or sage accent, light typography, breathable)
dark_yellow_bold (F45: white bg, #cf2e2e red + #fcb900 yellow + #0693e3 blue multi-accent, Source Sans Pro, high-energy)
clean_orange_energy (Orangetheory: #FFFFFF bg, #F26922 orange accent, #0077BD blue CTA, Roboto, pill buttons, approachable)
tech_modern_dark (Peloton: #181A1D dark sections, #F5F7F9 light sections, #D00C2A red accent, Inter + agrandir, minimal sharp edges)
luxury_black_minimal (Equinox: #000000 header, #FFFFFF headings, custom Equinox Sans, 0px radius, aspirational photography, 'dark' theme)
typography_mood: bold_industrial (Bebas Neue headings, all caps, tight letter-spacing — CrossFit, strength gyms)
modern_athletic (Montserrat bold headings, clean body — boutique, Equinox-style luxury)
serene_wellness (light serif or thin sans headings — yoga, Pilates, meditation)
custom_luxury (Equinox Sans proprietary — exclusive, high-end, not available on Google Fonts)
clean_system (Inter headings + Inter body — Peloton, coherent design system, Google Fonts)
classic_web (Roboto — Orangetheory, widely available, familiar, accessible)
functional_clean (Source Sans Pro — F45, readable, works with Bootstrap)
layout_density: bold_spacious (Equinox: large photos, minimalist cards, luxury feel, custom fonts, negative space)
high_energy_dense (CrossFit box: more info per viewport, class times visible, raw aesthetic)
community_grid (boutique: member photos, social proof, Instagram-feed-style gallery)
ecommerce_hybrid (Peloton: product pages meet fitness content, equipment + membership dual focus)
schedule_forward (Orangetheory/F45: class booking prominent, location finder, timetable-driven)

class_detail.best_practices: Video preview, intensity level clearly marked, duration, what to bring, suitable for beginners/pros

membership_page.best_practices: Transparent pricing, no hidden fees, clear cancelation policy, risk-reversal trial offer

schedule_page.best_practices: Filter by day/class type/trainer, show spots remaining, one-click booking (Glofox integration common)

equipment_page.best_practices: High-quality product photography, specs table, financing calculator, membership upsell, home trial offer
equipment_page.note: Specific to connected fitness brands like Peloton

location_finder.best_practices: Mapbox/Google Maps integration, geolocation, club amenities per location, 'Visit a Club' CTA per location
location_finder.note: Used by Equinox (ExploreClubs), Orangetheory, F45 with studio locator

equinox.fonts: Self-hosted Equinox Sans + Messina Sans Mono
